literal_frozen_clause.guard: all targets currently before or after; every necessary stage verified before any write
literal_frozen_clause.effects: Complete missing edits, clean verified unused stages, persist terminal state.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: RECOVERY_CONFLICT for third-party edits; COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN for I/O interruption; retry same recovery.

guard_assessment: Recover complete validates mode and journal, then every target must match before/after; all necessary stage bytes are hash-checked before the effect loop.
effect_assessment: Apply only missing after-images; hash-check unused stages before cleanup; mark committed through durable metadata update.
retry_assessment: Third digest refuses RECOVERY_CONFLICT. Early read/replace/remove errors may propagate directly while journal stays prepared; only failed terminal acknowledgement is wrapped COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN. This corrects the inherited all-I/O wording, not the kernel.

literal_frozen_clause.guard: all current targets before or after; backups hash-valid before any write
literal_frozen_clause.effects: Restore old bytes/delete new targets, clean stages, preserve transaction/history.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: All-target preflight prevents overwriting outside changes; incomplete recovery stays prepared.

guard_assessment: All targets match a journal before/after identity; all necessary rollback backups are checked before the effect loop.
effect_assessment: Restore before-images or remove originally absent targets; verify cleanup stages and retain history/journal.
retry_assessment: Third-party current bytes refuse before effects. Required material failure leaves prepared journal. No arbitrary undo or third-party overwrite authority.

literal_frozen_clause.guard: valid terminal journal
literal_frozen_clause.effects: Return replay without reapplying inverse/forward edits.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: Recovery is not general undo of a committed arbitrary write.

guard_assessment: Decode and validate the existing terminal journal before considering its state.
effect_assessment: If not prepared, return same terminal outcome/replay immediately without effects.
retry_assessment: Recover complete/rollback cannot undo a committed operation. Later source edits are not reversed by terminal replay.

literal_frozen_clause.event: target has third digest / missing recovery material
literal_frozen_clause.guard: preflight mismatch
literal_frozen_clause.effects: No preflight mutation; preserve evidence for manual reconciliation.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: RECOVERY_CONFLICT; must resolve actual bytes before retry.

guard_assessment: Preflight every current target and each required recovery input before the effect loop.
effect_assessment: Third digest or missing/changed necessary stage/backup returns without target mutation; evidence is retained.
retry_assessment: Third digest uses RECOVERY_CONFLICT; missing recovery material uses CORRUPT_JOURNAL, not universally RECOVERY_CONFLICT. Both are literal fd7/current behavior; actual bytes/material must be reconciled.

literal_frozen_clause.guard: invalid shape/name/path/hash, unreadable, listed file disappears
literal_frozen_clause.effects: Refuse to treat store as clean.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: CORRUPT_JOURNAL / RECOVERY_REQUIRED / I/O diagnostic.

guard_assessment: Strict anchored scan/name/opID/journal-shape/digest/target/stage/backups and bounded result; links/unreadable entries are errors.
effect_assessment: Never infer a clean store from malformed or missing-listed journal; .next is explicitly nonauthoritative.
retry_assessment: CORRUPT_JOURNAL, RECOVERY_REQUIRED or contextual I/O error propagates. Current ancestor/descendant target-collision rejection strengthens closed journal admission; disjoint targets remain valid.

literal_frozen_clause.guard: closed supported kind and schema, unique identity/path
literal_frozen_clause.effects: Create revision 1, typed normative state, presentation, checksums; plan tasks PENDING, governance draft.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: Duplicate identity, existing canonical slug or catalog bounds refuse.

guard_assessment: Closed public kind/schema/ID/slug; catalog identity unique; legacy Markdown/canonical HTML target absent; new plan binds exact current selected spec.
effect_assessment: Revision1/model checksums/canonical presentation; draft governance; syncExecution initializes plan tasks PENDING. Created structure is checked by render.Prepare.
retry_assessment: Duplicate IDs/path, incompatible binding, existing target and catalog count/byte caps refuse before Commit.

literal_frozen_clause.guard: historical schema supported and no newer fields mislabeled
literal_frozen_clause.effects: Validate and expose without automatic upgrade or recertification.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: Unsupported versions/assistive fields under old labels fail closed.

guard_assessment: Read only supported schema labels; assistive fields cannot masquerade under0.3.0/1; typed retirement requires non-work0.3.4; mapped work fields require work0.3.3.
effect_assessment: Schema/symbol/integrity/render validation exposes historical bytes without rewriting or recertifying them.
retry_assessment: Unsupported/newer fields or labels fail closed. NT05/NT09 add feature-gated0.3.4, not unconditional migration of old documents.

literal_frozen_clause.guard: new fields required
literal_frozen_clause.effects: Write appropriate 0.3.2/0.3.3 schema while retaining history.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: No silent reinterpretation on read.

guard_assessment: Only actual new fields/changed progress semantics trigger a feature version; work has its own0.3.3 coordination epoch.
effect_assessment: Assistive writes require at least0.3.2; typed retirement and changed dependency propagation use0.3.4 under NT05/NT09. RequiredVersion/AtLeast never downgrade a later label.
retry_assessment: Read itself does not upgrade. Frozen0.3.2/0.3.3 wording is extended explicitly by accepted0.3.4 semantics; old history/receipt hashes stay at their real epoch.

literal_frozen_clause.guard: unique ID; correct directory/kind; no same-slug HTML+Markdown
literal_frozen_clause.effects: Spec and plan directories remain strict on catalog scans; optional kinds read only when active.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: One invalid strict spec/plan can reject unrelated catalog-based operation; selected work avoids broad catalog.

guard_assessment: Strict active codec/directory/kind and unique ID; refuse same-slug HTML+Markdown; anchored no-follow/bounded catalog.
effect_assessment: Spec/plan remain strict on catalog scans; optional knowledge/decomposition/work only scanned when selected. Selected work uses exact owned work path.
retry_assessment: One bad strict spec/plan can refuse catalog operations; unrelated optional kinds do not silently become broad dependencies.

literal_frozen_clause.guard: nonblank resolution; valid references
literal_frozen_clause.effects: Update normative record; formerly blocking readiness may clear.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: Resolved without resolution is structurally invalid.

guard_assessment: Closed schema status vocabulary and live references; resolved requires nonblank resolution.
effect_assessment: Generic typed record.update changes the normative record; a formerly blocking decision can then satisfy readiness.
retry_assessment: Missing resolution is INVALID_DECISION; failed model/render validation prevents save. A stored resolution is not newly authenticated user approval.

literal_frozen_clause.guard: valid closed schema
literal_frozen_clause.effects: Retain explicit unresolved state; blocking decision causes Ready failure.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: No specialized irreversible transition policy: generic apply permits reopening. Deferred is a criterion disposition or decomposition question state, not a spec open-decision status.

guard_assessment: Closed open/resolved spec open-decision vocabulary; normal typed update and CAS.
effect_assessment: Reopen remains possible; blocking nonresolved decision yields OPEN_BLOCKER from Ready.
retry_assessment: No irreversible native transition policy; deferred belongs to other typed scopes. Ready is a structural/evidence-consumer contract, not an ADR43 blanket permission gate on ordinary independent work.

literal_frozen_clause.guard: all required semantic fields; named tests for test commands; DAG/partition/input coverage; spec criterion mapping
literal_frozen_clause.effects: Return deterministic diagnostics; does not approve.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: OPEN_BLOCKER, uncovered criterion/scope/input, invalid command etc remain diagnostic.

guard_assessment: Structural references/DAG/checkpoint partition/path policy plus nonblank semantic fields; recognized test commands require named tests; all selected spec criteria covered/permitted disposition.
effect_assessment: Return sorted bounded diagnostics/readiness assessment without approval or command execution.
retry_assessment: OPEN_BLOCKER, uncovered scope/criterion/input, invalid command/path and oversized record remain diagnostic. Custom runner recognition is explicitly finite; no claim of universal shell parsing/build-closure inference.

literal_frozen_clause.guard: Ready/Binding checks
literal_frozen_clause.effects: Refuse active not-applicable criterion or mandatory criterion disposition.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: Must explicitly revise/retire outcome with reason; no automatic task execution.

guard_assessment: Active criterion not_applicable is not ready; mandatory must criterion cannot be disposed; coverage/disposition cannot overlap.
effect_assessment: Return NOT_READY/UNCOVERED_CRITERION; explicit supported revision/retirement is needed.
retry_assessment: No automatic task execution, outcome retirement or user-decision creation. NT05 typed retired ownership is preserved, not fabricated from ID prefixes.

literal_frozen_clause.guard: Ready approved plan+spec, approved_source binding, strict prereqs, current snapshot, both exact receipts, completion rules
literal_frozen_clause.effects: Append both refs, set/retain exact completion receipt selection; establish scope baseline if absent.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: Stale plan baseline needs scope-reconcile; failed/missing named tests/stale refs reject.

guard_assessment: Only receipt-bearing task-review enters strict branch: current ready approved plan/spec, approved_source, strict prereqs/snapshot, dispatched state, exact verification+spec_review payloads and completion constraints.
effect_assessment: On clone append both refs, REVIEW state, establish missing scope baseline or require plan-hash reconciliation; retain exact explicit completion selection.
retry_assessment: Stale/missing/failed/skipped named results/receipt/subject or completion downgrade refuses before save. Ordinary no-receipt review routes to recordWork before these gates; no native global one-review-ever gate is invented (NT11).

literal_frozen_clause.guard: current reconciliation receipt exact input/task/target; REVIEW additionally TaskFresh
literal_frozen_clause.effects: Append evidence/reason; target other than REVIEW transitively invalidates dependents.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: Invalid receipt/input/claim rejects all changes.

guard_assessment: Receipt-bearing reconcile requires current exact receipt subject/task/input/target; REVIEW additionally requires TaskFresh.
effect_assessment: Append receipt/reason, set selected target. Accepted ADR0046/NT09 preserves dependent recorded progress/history; non-REVIEW upgrades changed semantics to at least0.3.4.
retry_assessment: Invalid subject/input/claim refuses atomically. Frozen destructive transitive STALE overwrite is intentionally superseded, not claimed preserved. Ordinary no-receipt reconcile remains separately authorized progress.

literal_frozen_clause.guard: current exact reconciliation receipt for scope/input
literal_frozen_clause.effects: Set base input and plan hashes; append reconciliation to member tasks.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: Preserve prior evidence; cannot silently convert stale baseline.

guard_assessment: Selected checkpoint and exact current reconciliation receipt/subject/current input plus nonblank assessment; strict plan/spec/prereqs/snapshot already passed.
effect_assessment: Set scope base_input and plan hashes on clone; append receipt to every member without deleting prior refs.
retry_assessment: Missing/stale source or malformed receipt refuses before save; no silent baseline restamp and no ordinary-start baseline requirement.

literal_frozen_clause.guard: previous checkpoint accepted fresh; every member TaskFresh; exact current quality/completion evidence
literal_frozen_clause.effects: Accept entire scope atomically, append quality receipt.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: Any failed member or prior scope refuses entire transition.

guard_assessment: Strict quality path requires prior checkpoints AcceptedFresh, every member REVIEW/ACCEPTED and TaskFresh, exact complete quality/task hashes and completion selection.
effect_assessment: Only after all member checks, set every cloned member ACCEPTED and append quality receipt; one journaled save.
retry_assessment: Any prior/member/quality/completion failure refuses all acceptance. No-receipt accept-scope uses finishScope and records DONE only, not verified acceptance.

literal_frozen_clause.guard: strict guards+prereqs+snapshot
literal_frozen_clause.effects: Project all_accepted_and_current only when every task ACCEPTED, fresh, no conflicting checks or unassessed trimmed history.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: May fail due to approval, stale source, infrastructure or missing evidence; never treats DONE/REVIEW as verification.

guard_assessment: Plan kind, strict guards/prereq receipt assessment and coherent current snapshot precede each acceptance/currentness assessment.
effect_assessment: Read-only all_accepted_and_current requires ACCEPTED+AcceptedFresh for every task and no conflicting reports or unassessed trimmed history.
retry_assessment: Approval/source/receipt/infrastructure failures propagate; DONE/REVIEW cannot substitute. Historical progress labels remain independently visible under ADR46.

literal_frozen_clause.guard: definition kind fact/decision; source+summary; valid outcome; decision resolution requires user_statement
literal_frozen_clause.effects: Record caller_reported origin,time,definition digest; legacy flag/evidence not overwritten.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: Agent/tool may record unknown decision; cannot assert resolved decision as agent/tool.

guard_assessment: Live fact/decision definition, closed outcome/origin, nonblank source+summary; a nonunknown decision needs user_statement.
effect_assessment: Store caller_reported outcome/source/origin/time/exact definition digest; leave legacy satisfied flag/evidence intact; monotonic versioning.
retry_assessment: Unknown agent/tool decision can be recorded, but cannot be mislabeled as resolved user choice. No source execution/host attestation/receipt required for ordinary observation.

literal_frozen_clause.guard: current definition digest differs
literal_frozen_clause.effects: Expose stale observation as unknown, retain original.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: No automatic recertification.

guard_assessment: Compare observation definition_sha256 with current id/kind/requirement/task_refs/source_refs digest.
effect_assessment: Mismatch exposes outcome unknown/definition_current=false while retaining original observation object.
retry_assessment: Title/unrelated edits do not silently recertify or invalidate the definition; read performs no source/receipt execution or refresh.

literal_frozen_clause.guard: historical receipt not live assessed here
literal_frozen_clause.effects: Report recorded legacy flag separately.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: Never silently promote old satisfied flag into fresh observed fact.

guard_assessment: No ordinary observation, legacy satisfied flag present; ordinary projection does not load its receipt as live authority.
effect_assessment: Expose legacy_receipt_unassessed, recorded_state and unknown outcome/evidence_assessed=false.
retry_assessment: Never silently turn historical satisfied into current observed fact; report remains distinct from explicit strict receipt consumer.

literal_frozen_clause.guard: strict guards+snapshot; exact current prerequisite receipt
literal_frozen_clause.effects: Delete ordinary observation for ID, set legacy satisfied and append receipt.
literal_frozen_clause.failure_retry: Strict consumers require legacy receipts and reject presence of ordinary observation.

guard_assessment: Explicit receipted branch requires strict plan/spec, coherent snapshot and current exact prerequisite receipt.
effect_assessment: Delete only selected ordinary observation, set selected legacy satisfied and append receipt; save clone/journal atomically.
retry_assessment: Strict consumer rejects ordinary observation even if legacy flag exists; missing flag/reference/current receipt refuses. Structural satisfied-without-evidence fails MISSING_EVIDENCE even before consumer; ordinary observations do not adopt this permission ceremony.
